judgements.built: plan first, text second. Every document is generated from a record saying which service it is about, which aspect of that service it covers, and which planted value it states. The judgements are read off those records, so no document was judged by looking at it afterwards.

grades.3: states the answer to the question: the handbook page for that service and aspect, and the field note that repeats the same value under the service code.
grades.2: the same service, on one of the two aspects the handbook cross-references from the one asked about. Useful to the reader, does not contain the answer.
grades.1: names the service and the aspect in passing without stating the value, which is what the runbooks do.
grades.0: everything else, including the service index and the change logs. Both carry service names and aspect wording and neither states a value.

judgements.unlisted: a document id absent from a relevance map is graded 0.
